title: 鲑鱼生命周期
prompt: Describe the salmon life cycle, including habitats, approximate durations and fish sizes. Show the return to the original habitat.
book_ref: 剑雅 10 Academic · Test 4 · Writing Task 1

stages: Eggs among reeds and small stones in the slow upper river: about 5-6 months
Fry, 3-8 cm, move to the fast-flowing lower river: about 4 years
Smolt, 12-15 cm, migrate to the open sea: about 5 years
Adult salmon, 70-76 cm, return upstream to reproduce
